summary: Iteration 15 — Rim Size + AI Tyre Replacement Estimate feature verified end-to-end. BACKEND (/app/backend/tests/test_tyre_estimate.py, 20 tests): 20/20 PASS in 13.4s. Coverage: (a) rim_size Optional[int] 12-26 — 17/18/19 accepted, boundaries 12 & 26 accepted, out-of-range 11/27/-1/0/100 → 422, omitted → 200 with null, explicit null → 200. (b) GET /api/submissions/{id} returns rim_size on the wire (no _id leak). (c) POST /api/submissions/{sub_id}/tyre-estimate authz — unauthenticated → 401, dealer JWT → 403. (d) Happy path with BMW 3 Series 320i M-Sport 2020 rim=18 → real GPT-5.2 call succeeds in ~10s, returns {estimate:{tyre_spec:'225/45 R18', per_tyre_range_zar, set_of_four_zar{low:11000,typical:17400,high:25000}, fitment_and_balance_zar, total_replacement_estimate_zar:19000, recommended_brands:['Bridgestone','Michelin','Continental'], notes, confidence:'medium', disclaimer}, rim_size:18, generated_at:iso, model:'gpt-5.2'}. All shape checks: tyre_spec contains 'R18' ✓, set_of_four_zar has int low/typical/high in SA range with low<=typical<=high ✓, total>0 ✓, recommended_brands non-empty ✓. (e) After call, sub.tyre_estimate + sub.tyre_estimate_at persisted. (f) Second call regenerates — generated_at differs, cache overwrites both in response and persisted doc. (g) Regression: dealer GET /submissions/my (200), admin GET /submissions (200), admin GET /billing (200), market-analysis endpoint untouched. DONE commits selection — field text becomes '<n>″'. Right-column bottom shows both 'AI MARKET ANALYSIS' + 'TYRE REPLACEMENT ESTIMATE' cards. admin-tyre-estimate-button visible; because the sub already had a cached estimate the button label reads 'REFRESH' (not 'ESTIMATE'). Card visible with all fields: tyre spec badge '225/45 R18', 'Rim: 18″' label, big 'Total 4-tyre replacement R 17,450' figure, SET LOW R 11,200 / TYPICAL R 15,600 (typical column highlighted) / SET HIGH R 20,800, PER TYPE R 3,900 + FITMENT & BALANCE R 1,850, RECOMMENDED BRANDS list (Michelin, Continental, Bridgestone). Clicking REFRESH → 20s later card repopulated with new figures (Total R 19,000; SET LOW R 11,000 / TYPICAL R 17,400 / SET HIGH R 25,000; PER TYPE R 4,350 / FITMENT R 1,600) proving fresh LLM call + cache overwrite. Button remains REFRESH. tyre-estimate-card testID rendered (transiently null during reload). Backend confirmed via GET /api/submissions/{id} that tyre_estimate + tyre_estimate_at update on second call. NO regressions observed. AI MARKET ANALYSIS card still shows its 'Click ANALYSE for a GPT-5.2 market overview…' body untouched. GPT-5.2 recommended brands, tyre spec (225/45 R18), and Rand ranges are all sensible for the SA market.
